donarInternacional.title: International donations
donarInternacional.lede: Channels you can use from any country — they accept foreign cards or PayPal, no Colombian bank account required. For local transfers in pesos and donation points by city, see the general donation page.

warnings.trustLevel: Check each campaign's trust level — “Verified” only means we confirmed the organization, not that we vouch for how it manages funds.
warnings.individualNote: GoFundMe campaigns run by an individual organizer (not an institution) carry a note whenever we find something worth mentioning — read it before donating.
warnings.distrust: Be wary of channels shared only via WhatsApp/SMS with no other trace, and of urgency pressure.

sections.individualSubtext: Individual fundraisers, not institutions — check each one's trust level before donating.
